raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## AITER prerequisites

- [ROCm/aiter#6026](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6026) — fused KDA decode on gfx950, exported as `flydsl_kda_decode_with_f_b` and `is_flydsl_kda_decode_supported`.

This stays off the measured hot path, which compiles the vendored SGLang kernel (`SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_FLYDSL_SOURCE=sglang`).

## Motivation

With `SGLANG_K3_FLYDSL_SOURCE=aiter`, the Kimi-K3 fused KDA decode loads `aiter.ops.flydsl.kimi_k3_kda_decode`, which no AITER release ships. ROCm/aiter#6026 exports the same kernels from `aiter.ops.flydsl` as `flydsl_kda_decode_with_f_b` and `is_flydsl_kda_decode_supported`, so the fused path silently stays off on AITER.

## Modifications

- Resolve the decode and its support predicate by the vendored names first, then by the names ROCm/aiter#6026 exports.
- Import `aiter.ops.flydsl` for the `aiter` source.
- Read the fused-backend switch as `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_KDA_FUSED_BACKEND`. `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_KDA_FUSED_BACKEND` remains a deprecated alias.
- Keep the backend off when AITER predates #6026 instead of failing on a missing attribute.
- Test the name resolution, and that the vendored and #6026 kernels agree on output, recurrent state and conv state at batch 1, 8 and 16.

## Accuracy Tests

`test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/kda_flydsl/test_kimi_k3_kda_decode.py` on MI355X with ROCm/aiter `main` plus #6026: 20 passed, none skipped. Relative RMSE between the vendored and #6026 kernels is below 1e-3; conv state matches exactly. No default changes, so no speed claim.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 the [DCP KV-free fix (#38941)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38941).
 No source overlay is required for DCP.
 
-Keep `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_KDA_FUSED_BACKEND` unset with this image. The separate fused-KDA
+Keep `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_KDA_FUSED_BACKEND` unset with this image. The separate fused-KDA
 opt-in requires the [deferred-gate fix (#39066)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39066),
 which is not included in this image. This updated recipe remains **Final
 Verification In Progress**; the recorded speed numbers use their original
@@ -221,7 +221,7 @@ Outside the two verified B300 1×8 `Unified` cells, no cell has a serving round
 |---|---|---|
 | `AITER_SITUV2_A8W4=1` | unset | SiTU v2 MoE with A8W4 activation quantization, on AITER's GU-interleaved preshuffled weight layout. The performance default the cell ships. |
 | `AITER_SITUV2_A4W4=1` | unset | A4W4 instead, on the generic separated shuffle layout. Numerically correct but slower than A8W4 (530.8 vs 537.3 tok/s median output on 8×MI35x). Setting **both** gives A8W4 precedence — SGLang follows AITER and keeps the GU-interleaved layout. |
-| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_KDA_FUSED_BACKEND=aiter` | unset | Opt in to the fused ROCm KDA decode boundary: the `f_b` projection is deferred into the gfx950 FlyDSL kernel so decode fuses `f_b` + convolution + recurrent state update + gated RMSNorm. Any other value (or unset) keeps the unfused KDA path. |
+| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_KDA_FUSED_BACKEND=aiter` | unset | Opt in to the fused ROCm KDA decode boundary: the `f_b` projection is deferred into the gfx950 FlyDSL kernel so decode fuses `f_b` + convolution + recurrent state update + gated RMSNorm. Any other value (or unset) keeps the unfused KDA path. |
 | `SGLANG_K3_FLYDSL_SOURCE` | `auto` | Which FlyDSL implementation backs the fused decode: `auto` prefers SGLang's vendored kernels and falls back to the AITER module, `sglang` / `aiter` pin one. Leave it alone unless you are bisecting the two. |
 
 The fused KDA backend is fail-closed at two levels: it arms during model init only when the flag is exactly `aiter` **and** the gfx950 FlyDSL kernels are importable, and each decode step re-validates shapes, dtypes, strides, state indices, and output buffers before dispatch — anything unexpected falls back to the stock KDA implementation rather than erroring. Batch size 2 automatically picks a separately validated kernel schedule; every other batch keeps the original build options. Measured on a 69-layer graph the fused boundary is 9.20 → 8.38 µs/layer (−8.9%), with GSM8K 1319 at 0.950.

@@ -1907,6 +1907,11 @@ SGLang supports various environment variables that can be used to configure its Token count above which SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FUSE_KDA_INPROJ stops applying and the split projection runs instead. The merged shape is only faster while the projection is bandwidth bound. 256 + + SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_KDA_FUSED_BACKEND + Kimi-K3 on ROCm: backend for the fused KDA decode. Empty keeps the unfused chain; aiter selects the gfx950 FlyDSL kernel. SGLANG_ROCM_K3_KDA_FUSED_BACKEND remains a deprecated alias. + "" +

+    try:

+    except AttributeError:

+        output_gate=aiter_inputs.output_gate,

+        norm_eps=_NORM_EPS,
